name: A Infera No Meu PC
source:
You don’t expect anything to happen. You just download a game. It turns out to be pirated. That single mistake is enough. Amália, an infernal being with a sharp tongue and too much free time, steps in. Instead of punishment, she offers a challenge. Seven days to impress her.

[From [url=https://endydreams.itch.io/the-demon-on-my-pc]Itch.io[/url]]
